description: Synchronize registry/tool_manifest.json with discovered tools/*_cpp directories reported by scripts/check_manifest_gaps.py without promoting certification or evidence status.

changes.change: Added conservative C1 inventory entries for 11 existing C++ tool directories that were absent from the tool manifest.
Set certification, falsification, numerical stability, uncertainty, and provenance flags to false where no tool-local certification manifest was used.

non_claims: No tool was promoted to C4, C5, or C6.
No validation evidence was fabricated or inferred from directory presence.
This patch records inventory presence only.

verification.precondition: scripts/check_manifest_gaps.py reported 11 C++ directories missing from registry/tool_manifest.json.
